title: Source review: USB 3 SuperSpeed device-mode bring-up plan for S5E9945 from the pinned Samsung kernel (USBDP combo PHY, TCA/orientation, DWC3 SS config, PIPE3 clocks/power) with a safe HS fallback; what Android's 5000 Mbit/s link proves and what the loader lacks
acceptance: Ordered register-operation plan with file:line citations at the pinned SHA for every SS step (power domain, clocks, PHY init/tune, orientation, DWC3 GUSB3PIPECTL/DCFG), separated from the existing USB2 ladder
Each step classed as reuse-from-Android-state vs must-do; unknowns listed with the read-only Android check that resolves them
Fallback design: device returns to HS within a bounded time if the SS link does not train; no PMIC writes
